editorNote: A risk-off Tuesday: gold and bitcoin both slid, and space stocks gave back Monday's rally. Source text for several items was limited to headlines, which the summaries reflect.

stories.headline: Gold falls 1.80% on Nov. 24, USA Today reports; Kitco has it testing support near $3,600
stories.summary: USA Today's daily gold tracker has gold down 1.80% on Nov. 24, while Kitco's headline has the price testing support near $3,600 as U.S. consumer confidence rose sharply in November.
stories.whyItMatters: Gold, a watchlist holding, kept sliding a day after Monday's bounce.

sourceLinks.title: Gold Price Today: Gold Falls 1.80% on November 24, 2026 - USA Today
Gold price testing support near $3,600 as US Consumer Confidence sees sharp rise in November - Kitco

stories.headline: Bitcoin drops below $60,000 and gives back its Nvidia-rally gains, Forbes says
stories.summary: Forbes reports bitcoin fell below $60,000, erasing gains from the Nvidia rally; Bloomberg's headline says it failed to hold the bump, and Yahoo Finance notes it nears $60K despite another Strategy purchase.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin, a watchlist holding, is back near the two-year-low zone it hit last week.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin Price Drops Below $60,000 As Crypto Market Erases Gains From Nvidia Rally - Forbes
Bitcoin Fails to Hold Nvidia Bump With Crypto Headwinds in Focus - Bloomberg
Bitcoin Price Nears $60K Despite Saylor's BTC Buy - Yahoo Finance

stories.headline: Rocket Lab falls 9% as space stocks retrace Monday's rally, 24/7 Wall St. reports
stories.summary: 24/7 Wall St. has AST SpaceMobile down 11%, Rocket Lab down 9% and SpaceX down 6% amid reported Tesla merger talks; Benzinga separately headlines a 6% Rocket Lab drop.
stories.whyItMatters: Rocket Lab gave back much of Monday's 11% rebound.

stories.headline: Alphabet adds wallet data to its AI search, Yahoo Finance reports
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance's headline says Alphabet (GOOGL) is expanding AI search with wallet data; FXLeaders separately has the stock testing support as analysts reduce exposure and spending fears mount.
stories.whyItMatters: The story is a product expansion; the source text was not available beyond its headline.

stories.headline: DA Davidson reiterates its Buy rating on Duolingo, citing a Pokemon Go lift, Investing.com reports
stories.summary: Investing.com's headline says DA Davidson reiterated its Buy rating on Duolingo (DUOL) on a Pokemon Go lift.
stories.whyItMatters: An analyst rating reiteration is a disclosed view, not a change in Duolingo's reported results.
